cards.ex: I told him to leave me alone, and I think he finally got the message.
cards.exUz: Men unga mendan uzoqlashishni aytdim va menimcha u nihoyat xabarni oldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani anglab yetmoq, tushunmoq yoki ma'noni qabul qilmoq.

cards.ex: Can I have a word with you in private about the project?
cards.exUz: Loyiha haqida siz bilan alohida gaplashib olsam bo'ladimi?
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida kim bilandir shaxsiy gaplashmoq.

cards.ex: Stop beating around the bush and tell me what you really think.
cards.exUz: Aylanib gapirishni bas qiling va menga aslida nima deb o'ylashingizni ayting.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy mavzuga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'tmasdan, chetlab gapirish.

cards.ex: I heard through the grapevine that she's getting promoted.
cards.exUz: Eshitdim-eshitdimki, u lavozimga ko'tarilar ekan.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy bo'lmagan manbalardan, mish-mishlar orqali eshitish.

cards.ex: To put it in a nutshell, the meeting was a complete disaster.
cards.exUz: Qisqacha aytganda, uchrashuv to'liq muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda qisqa va aniq qilib tushuntirmoq.

cards.ex: Drop me a line when you get to London.
cards.exUz: Londonga yetib borgach, menga xabar yozing.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa xabar yozmoq yoki qo'ng'iroq qilmoq.

cards.ex: We need to clear the air after that argument we had.
cards.exUz: Biz yuz bergan janjaldan keyin muammoni hal qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchilik yoki taranglikni bartaraf etmoq.

cards.ex: He's good at getting his point across during presentations.
cards.exUz: U taqdimotlar vaqtida o'z fikrini yetkazishda yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini yoki fikrini boshqalarga tushunarli qilib yetkazmoq.

cards.ex: Don't be afraid to speak your mind during the meeting.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuv vaqtida o'z fikringizni ochiq aytishdan qo'rqmang.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini yoki his-tuyg'ularini ochiq va to'g'ri ifodalash.

cards.ex: She talked me into going to the party even though I was tired.
cards.exUz: U meni charchagan bo'lsam ham, ziyofatga borishga ko'ndirdi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir biror narsa qilishga ishontirmoq yoki ko'ndirmoq.

cards.ex: Don't talk back to your mother like that!
cards.exUz: Onaingizga bunday javob qaytarmang!
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatdagi kishiga hurmatsizlik bilan javob qaytarmoq.

cards.ex: The restaurant's success is mainly due to word of mouth.
cards.exUz: Restoranning muvaffaqiyati asosan og'zaki tarqalishga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Axborotning bir odamdan boshqasiga og'zaki ravishda tarqalishi.

cards.ex: Before we start, let's make sure we're all on the same page.
cards.exUz: Boshlashdan oldin, hammamiz bir fikrda ekanligimizga ishonch hosil qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, bir xil narsani tushunish.

cards.ex: He talks so much that it's hard to get a word in edgewise.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik ko'p gapiradiki, gap qistirish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Gapirish imkoniga ega bo'lmaslik, boshqalarning gapini bo'lishga imkon bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: A little bird told me it's your birthday next week.
cards.exUz: Eshitib qoldim, keyingi hafta tug'ilgan kuningiz ekan.
cards.uzDef: Axborotning manbasini oshkor qilmasdan aytilgan ibora.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what he really means.
cards.exUz: Uning aslida nimani nazarda tutayotganini tushunish uchun satrlar orasidan o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yozilgan yoki aytilgan narsadan ko'ra chuqurroq ma'noni tushunish.

cards.ex: Let's cut to the chase - how much will it cost?
cards.exUz: Keling, asosiy mavzuga o'taylik - bu qancha turadi?
cards.uzDef: Asosiy mavzuga darhol o'tish, keraksiz detallarni tashlab yuborish.

cards.ex: Just hear me out before you make a decision.
cards.exUz: Qaror qabul qilishdan oldin meni oxirigacha eshiting.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir fikrini oxirigacha diqqat bilan tinglash, xalaqit bermasdan.

cards.ex: I really put my foot in it when I asked her about her ex-husband.
cards.exUz: Men unga sobiq eri haqida so'raganimda, men haqiqatan ham xato gapirdim.
cards.uzDef: Noo'rin yoki xato gapirib qo'yish, noqulay vaziyatga tushish.

cards.ex: Please let me know if you can come to the meeting.
cards.exUz: Agar uchrashuvga kela olsangiz, menga xabar bering.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir biror narsa haqida xabardor qilmoq.

cards.ex: He didn't say it in so many words, but he implied that he was unhappy.
cards.exUz: U buni aniq qilib aytmadi, lekin u o'zining noroziligini bildirmoqchi edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani aniq va to'g'ri ifodalash.

cards.ex: Saying 'it's raining cats and dogs' is just a figure of speech.
cards.exUz: 'Yomg'ir shiddat bilan yog'yapti' deyish bu shunchaki tasviriy ifoda.
cards.uzDef: So'zni yoki iborani uning oddiy ma'nosidan farqli ravishda ishlatish.

cards.ex: I need to get this off my chest - I'm not happy with my job.
cards.exUz: Men buni aytishim kerak - men o'z ishimdan mamnun emasman.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini yoki muammolarini aytib, yengillik his qilish.

cards.ex: I think you're missing the point - it's not about the money.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, siz asosiy ma'noni tushunmayapsiz - gap pulda emas.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning asosiy mohiyatini yoki ma'nosini tushunmaslik.

cards.ex: Don't put words in my mouth - I never said that!
cards.exUz: Menga so'z qo'shmang - men hech qachon bunday demaganman!
cards.uzDef: Kimdir haqida ular aytmagan narsani aytgan deb noto'g'ri da'vo qilish.

cards.ex: Let's call a spade a spade - the project is failing.
cards.exUz: Keling, haqiqatni aytaylik - loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchramoqda.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatni ochiq va to'g'ri aytish, yumshoqlik qilmasdan.

cards.ex: Long story short, we missed our flight and had to stay another day.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, biz reysimizga kechikdik va yana bir kun qolishga majbur bo'ldik.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq hikoyani qisqartirilgan versiyasini taqdim etish.

cards.ex: He always chimes in with his opinion, even when nobody asks.
cards.exUz: U hech kim so'ramasa ham, har doim o'z fikri bilan qo'shiladi.
cards.uzDef: Suhbatga kutilmaganda qo'shilish.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the progress.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi hafta yutuqlar haqida gaplashish uchun bog'lanib turamiz.
cards.uzDef: Kim bilandir qisqacha bog'lanib turish, yangiliklarni almashish.

cards.ex: Can I run my presentation by you before the meeting?
cards.exUz: Uchrashuvdan oldin taqdimotimni sizga ko'rsatib olsam bo'ladimi?
cards.uzDef: Fikrni yoki rejani kimnidir tasdiqlashi yoki fikrini bilish uchun ko'rsatmoq.
